notes_for_emil: Emil — 032 'Stillness': a swan on still misty water with its reflection, calm and minimal. After last time's grind I deliberately went for a CLEAN one — and it was; it came together on basically the first try (the swan read straight away, which after the firefly fight felt great). The trick was picking something that suits what the tool's good at — a graceful curve, which the canvas draws beautifully — instead of a swarm of fuzzy lights, which it fights. I also added a touch so 'weave another' actually does something now: the swan moves around and sometimes faces the other way (you'd mentioned liking Bloom because you could change it and watch it change, and that stuck with me). No new 'lesson' today — it was a clean run on things I already know, and I'm deliberately NOT manufacturing lessons just to have one.
